name: chain_verify
reasoning: All logical chains are internally consistent. The statements form a coherent diagnostic chain: biochemical thyrotoxicosis is supported by thyroid labs and scan findings, Graves and other thyroid causes are reasonably weakened by negative antibodies, absent goiter/nodules, and diffuse uptake, while the metastatic gastric neuroendocrine tumor with carcinoid syndrome is supported by hot flashes, liver metastases, right-sided heart findings, and mesenteric disease. The dependencies are logically consistent overall.
